sloka: नूनम् तत् शुभ दंत ओष्ठम् सुनासम् शुभ कुण्डलम् ।पूर्ण चंद्र निभम् ग्रस्तम् मुखम् निष्प्रभताम् गतम् ॥३-६०-३१॥
transliteration: nūnam tat śubha daṁta oṣṭham sunāsam śubha kuṇḍalam ।pūrṇa caṁdra nibham grastam mukham niṣprabhatām gatam ॥3-60-31॥

translations.english: Her beautiful face with her sparkling teeth and lips, wellshaped nose, shining earrings has been like the full moon, eclipsed and rendered pale.
